leads.claim: The claimant asserts they saw photographs of dead aliens, live aliens, autopsies, and an alien designated 'E.B.' held in captivity from 1949 to 1952.
leads.why: The claimant provides specific details regarding the types of biological evidence and the duration of custody for a specific entity.
leads.quote: I saw photographs of these dead alien's, of the craft; I saw photographs of live aliens; I saw photographs of 'autopsies

leads.claim: The claimant asserts the existence of a project to fly recovered alien craft that were obtained intact and undamaged.
leads.why: The claimant describes a specific program (Project Redlight) dedicated to the testing and operation of recovered extraterrestrial technology.
leads.quote: I saw a project that was, to fly recovered alien craft that had been recovered intact and un­ damaged

leads.claim: The document describes 'POUNCE' as a project to recover downed craft and 'REDLIGHT' as a project to test them at Area 51, noting aliens provided assistance.
leads.why: The text explicitly names recovery and testing programs and describes a collaborative relationship with extraterrestrials regarding the technology.
leads.quote: POUNCE the project formed to recover all downed/crashed craft and aliens. REDLIGHT is the ,project to test recovered alien craft.

leads.claim: The claimant asserts they were tasked with distributing advanced technology to defense contractors and universities for reverse engineering.
leads.why: The claim links government intelligence work to the transfer of advanced technology to private contractors for analysis, though it lacks specific material descriptions.
leads.custody_chain: Pentagon, Foreign Technology section of Army Intelligence
leads.quote: charged with the task of getting this advanced technology in the hands Jf defense contractors and universities, so they could reverse engineer

doc_verdict: The document contains multiple assertions from an anonymous narrator claiming the existence of recovered alien craft, biological entities, and government programs dedicated to their study and reverse engineering.
